content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Bitcoin ebook

When considering platforms for selling ebooks, options like Gumroad and Payhip offer user-friendly interfaces, but they come with steep transaction fees, limiting your profits. On the other hand, using NOWPayments in conjunction with a sovereign stack allows you to accept Bitcoin directly, maintaining a significantly lower fee structure at just 0.5%. This means more revenue remains in your pocket, essential for creators in regions where every dollar counts.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Many digital creators face challenges with payment processors due to geographical restrictions. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable in countries such as Zimbabwe and Kenya, leaving creators with few options. By implementing a sovereign stack that utilizes NOWPayments, creators can bypass these issues. This solution is designed for those locked out of traditional platforms, ensuring they can accept payments freely without reliance on third-party services.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The speed of payment processing matters greatly in the digital product market. NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain payment verification, ensuring that transactions are confirmed almost instantly. In contrast, platforms like Gumroad take a significant cut, charging 10% per sale. For a product priced at $97 with 100 monthly sales, this means losing $921 to fees alone. Choosing a sovereign stack with NOWPayments drastically reduces your fees, allowing you to retain more of your earnings.
Keep 99.5% of your revenue by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Digital product creators need a system that not only automates sales but also ensures data ownership. With a sovereign stack, you control the entire process, from hosting your products to managing payment verification and delivery. Tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automate file delivery instantly upon payment confirmation, providing a seamless experience for buyers. Unlike traditional platforms, you own all the data and infrastructure, eliminating risks associated with platform dependency.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The architecture you choose should align with your specific needs and the limitations you face. If you are selling ebooks or courses in a restricted market, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is your best bet. It includes all the blueprints and templates necessary to build a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently of conventional platforms. This kit empowers you to deploy, manage, and scale your online store efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate delivery and retain full ownership of your digital products seamlessly.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
